finding: The optimized split provider preserves the near-analytical F-AHL04C response but is about 6% slower end-to-end on this nonlinear fixture because it triggers one additional nonlinear iteration and one additional backtracking attempt.
interpretation: Constitutive micro-cost reduction alone is insufficient. Solver trajectory preservation is now the controlling performance question.
next_action: Preregister convergence attribution with exact theta and controlled C/K representation variants to identify which approximated constitutive component causes the extra iteration.
nonclaims: This does not reject adaptive hydraulics generally.
This is one nonlinear fixture and not a whole-SWAP performance result.
